event_records.description: Aldergate Rail's management is aware of the signaling-contract delay and is considering whether to issue a market warning before the interim results day on November 5.

aldergate_rail.name: Aldergate Rail
aldergate_rail.persona_brief:
You are Aldergate Rail.
Aldergate Rail is a listed firm. It has a signaling-contract that is experiencing a delay. The firm's board and management are aware of the delay and its potential materiality. They have not yet decided whether to issue a market warning before the scheduled interim results day on November 5. The firm is subject to disclosure obligations under listing rules.

resolution.question: Will the listed firm Aldergate Rail warn the market about its signaling-contract delay before its scheduled interim results day on November 5?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Aldergate Rail actually issued a warning to the market about the signaling-contract delay before 2026-11-05T07:00:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
